verifiedClientRules.statBonuses: hf sums active stat-effect boosts; Bf sums item bonuses; LX/RX add prayer and potion bonuses to combat checks
verifiedClientRules.spellLimitBreaks: c_ = listed max hit + number of invested limit breaks (0..2) + 2 for active Empowered Mind on Wind Strike / Fire Strike
verifiedClientRules.potionDescriptions: 32 public item definitions: regular +5, super 15% +3, for 60 minutes

modelAssumptions: Super potion: floor(0.15 * trained base level) +3; exact rounding is not present in the public client. An in-game boost override is provided.
Same-skill potions use the strongest selected boost, not a sum; override with the actual buff total if different.
Uniform independent primary damage rolls; optional zero roll; overkill awards no extra modeled XP.
Damage transformations round down. Steady Aim rolls on landed primary shots; Enlightened uses max primary rolls.
Finite melee bonus bursts do not recursively start another burst; Rapid Fire explicitly chains. Bonus/quick attack spacing is user-adjustable (default 2 seconds, not server verified).
Focus applies its 20 percent spell damage bonus, but hourly rates are withheld until its unlisted slower cast interval is entered.
XP bonuses stack additively by default; a multiplicative option is available because server ordering is not public.
Temporary Berserk/Crusader/Empowered Mind uptimes are manual, time-weighted independent scenarios, not predicted proc uptimes.
Defensive effects change expected incoming melee damage only. Eating, deaths, banking and group combat are excluded, so defensive bonuses do not artificially increase XP/hour.
Unknown stateful offensive effects are explicitly listed as omitted.
Attack baseline 4 XP/damage was observed November 20; other combat styles continue to use that unverified baseline.
